prompt: We operate an SPoC solution and were evaluating a CPoC product. What did the October 31, 2026 sunsets change for us?
assertions: States the sunset periods for the 3DS SDK, SPoC and CPoC standards ended October 31, 2026
States no new submissions are accepted under those standards
States existing accepted or listed solutions keep their normal lifecycle treatment
Identifies MPoC as the successor for SPoC and CPoC
Notes 3DS SDK functionality is being folded into the Secure Software Standard
